value.name: explains deferred payment options
value.description: The speaker explains that the beneficiaries may accept payment over time secured by the property, but that the applicable configuration is still uncertain.
evidence: the other beneficiaries are willing to accept a payment over time secured by the property itself.
There are configurations in which it would be possible. There are configurations in which it would not. I cannot tell you today which configuration applies.

value.name: advises Rosa to decide only whether to investigate
value.description: The speaker tells Rosa she does not need to decide today whether to keep the house, only whether she is willing to find out what would be required.
evidence: "You do not have to decide today whether you want to keep the house. You have to decide today only whether you are willing to find out what would be required."

value.name: Rosa agrees to investigate
value.description: After a long pause, Rosa says she is willing to find out what would be required to keep the house.
evidence: Rosa looked at her for a long moment.
"I am willing," she said, "to find out."

value.name: Daniel asks about financing structure
value.description: Daniel asks whether a payment arrangement secured by the house would effectively be a mortgage from Rosa to him and Lucia.
evidence: "If Rosa wants to keep the house. And if the appraisal comes in at a number she cannot pay outright. And if Lucia and I were to — were to be willing to accept a payment over time. The memorandum says secured by the property itself. Does that mean a mortgage. From her to us."

value.name: lawyer confirms purchase-money obligation
value.description: The lawyer confirms that the arrangement would be a purchase-money obligation secured by the house and negotiated among the three of them.
evidence: "In effect, yes. A purchase-money obligation, secured by the house, payable on terms the three of you would negotiate."

value.name: Daniel asks about interest rate
value.description: Daniel presses further and asks what interest rate would apply to the proposed obligation.

value.name: lawyer says parties can set any rate
value.description: The lawyer explains that the three parties could agree to any interest rate, including zero, though tax issues would need careful structuring.
evidence: "At whatever rate the three of you agree."

"It could be zero. It could also be the applicable federal rate. It could be anything in between. The IRS has views about very low rates among related parties, but you are not, in the technical sense, related parties, and even where the views apply they are manageable. We would structure it carefully."

value.name: Daniel is interrupted mid-thought
value.description: Daniel begins to react but is cut off before he can finish speaking.
